target_claim: For all irreducible generic smooth representations of GL(n), their normalized essential Whittaker vectors have the same restriction to the mirabolic subgroup P_n.
source_quote: Moreover, for all irreducible generic smooth representations $\pi$ of $G_n$, their essential vectors $W(g)$ are equal when restricted to $P_n$, the mirabolic subgroup, and $W(I)=1$.
